subject: Startups
subcategory: The Art of the Startup Pitch
title: The Market Size Slide
description: Learn The Market Size Slide in one minute.

hook.text: TAM, SAM, SOM—investors expect three numbers that describe how big your opportunity really is.

buildup.text: TAM is total market. SAM is serviceable market. SOM is what you can realistically capture in the near term.

discovery.text: VCs need a TAM of at least $1 billion. Smaller markets can't produce the 100x exits that make their model work.

twist.text: The best founders define markets that don't exist yet. Uber's TAM wasn't 'taxis'—it was 'all urban transportation.'

climax.text: A bottom-up approach is more credible: count potential customers times price. Top-down using industry reports is lazy.

punchline.text: Big markets forgive mistakes. Small markets don't.
